patch 1.34.9
notes.notes:
FIXES

+ Controller bug fixed.

BALANCING

+ Skeletal Dragon's ability has been buffed: now, it starts each wave with 50% HP. Above 50% HP, reduces healing received from 100% to 0% at 100% HP. Below 50% HP, increases healing received to from 100% to 200% at 0% HP.

notes.title: 1.31.1 Update
notes.notes:
BALANCING

+ The game has been completely rebalanced so that the player has a calmer start, while becoming more challenging in more distant waves.

+ The "SHORT TEMPER" card has been removed from the game for balance reasons.

CHANGES

+ The "FEAR FAIRY", "WALKING FORTRESS" and "TIME WARP" cards are now part of a new card rarity: Epic.

+ Epic Cards: Colored blue, they are rarer than "Rare" cards and can only be found once, each.

+ The "DANCING STONES" skill now deals much more damage when recast against enemies.

FIXES

+ Some bugs have been fixed:
    - The recast button for the "DANCING STONES" skill has been fixed.
    - Exponential armor stack has been removed.
